preview_heading: CPL 2026 final: Kensington Oval hosts the title decider
preview: The winners of Qualifier 1 and Qualifier 2 meet in the CPL 2026 final at Kensington Oval on September 20. Play starts at 7:00pm Barbados time, with the tournament title at stake.
preview_detail: The first finalist will be confirmed after Qualifier 1 between Antigua & Barbuda Falcons and Guyana Amazon Warriors on September 17. The second will be decided in Qualifier 2 on September 18. Team names will be updated after those results are confirmed, with the toss result and confirmed playing XIs added when announced on match day.
